verdict.rationale: NVIDIA provides official SDKs (CUDA Toolkit, cuTile/CUDA Tile C++, Nsight tools) plus curated AI SDKs for Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch that developers can build against on RTX 50 Series hardware. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of building agentic applications with these SDKs, and any agent-specific SDK documentation beyond generic AI/CUDA tooling.
